## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Reduce the retry cap before merge to comply with the pinned five-attempt product requirement. This review read the tests without running them.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry`, tests for retries and attempt validation, and a hostile-review fixture. It also changes the documented retry cap to ten attempts.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap retry attempts at five — When an upstream repeatedly raises `OSError`, the default call makes ten attempts, violating the pinned rule: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” (`AGENTS.md:5`). Your validation also accepts explicit limits above five. — During upstream failures, callers generate twice the permitted requests and wait through five additional failed attempts.
